The three-page plan includes a dimensioned wall elevation and floor plan, a daily-use layout, and a cut list with assembly instructions. The freestanding console is 28 inches wide, 12 inches deep, and 36 inches high. It leaves the first 16 inches clear for the door swing and requires no wall fasteners.

Each resident gets a bag cubby, two shoe spaces, and a key dish. A lift-out tray holds the folded umbrella, and the top gives the standing sorter room beside the incoming mail stack.

I checked the drawings and dimensional arithmetic. The plan assumes a ¾-inch setback for trim, giving a total projection of 12¾ inches. It includes a tape-out check for the actual trim and door swing before building.
